confirmed_strengths: The family is genuinely distinct: relative BTC/ETH target weights remain exactly 50/50 while only aggregate risky exposure changes, unlike fully invested inverse-volatility allocation and return-sign-driven trend.

The 40% annual target, hard scalar cap at one, zero floor, no leverage, fixed primary, four declared neighbors, and two additional variants are defensible ex ante and prohibit post-hoc primary replacement.
The fixed-sleeve estimator explicitly separates a hypothetical daily 50/50 estimator return from the actual weekly-rebalanced, between-fill drifting portfolio.
Strictly lagged information time, next-vector execution, independent doubled-cost and delay stresses, terminal cash, chronological folds, and zero-interest cash are appropriate.
Fourteen-basis-point one-way base cost, doubled-cost stress, additional-session delay, contribution reconciliation, concentration, regime, bootstrap, DSR, and PBO gates are conservative in intent.
The holdout remains closed and unread, no candidate exists, capital is zero, and prior terminal results are preserved.

prospective_decision_verdict.exact_count_rule: Count one decision for each unique experiment_id plus eligible Sunday signal-session end only after a complete target/source trace is materialized. A new Sunday counts even when its weights equal the previous target; reruns, retries, duplicate processing, or recomputation of the same Sunday key never count.

limitations: The 40% target is an ex-ante design choice rather than an economically identified optimum.
The estimator assumes a daily rebalanced 50/50 sleeve while actual holdings drift between weekly fills; this approximation must remain explicit.
The evidence applies only to fixed BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot paths and cannot support cross-sectional, delisting, or broad-universe claims.
One development year and four quarterly folds provide limited regime coverage.
Weekly prospective decisions with overlapping lookbacks are operationally distinct but strongly dependent, making the roughly 109-week minimum non-IID.
Fixed fees, spread, slippage, zero-interest cash, and no market-impact model are abstractions; no performance or deployability claim is justified at direction review.
